svg.text: Power grows with groups, not individuals
Size weights waste the extra individuals
the same test with size weights
Orange: equal power (about 0.5) with 20 groups of 1,000 and with 100 groups of 25, eight times fewer individuals.
Simulated data with a fixed population: groups differ by τ² = 0.02, and their population means relate to the annotations with R² = 0.5 (κ = 0.5, Kish 40%).
7,200 data sets, 300 per cell (standard error at most 0.03). N: individuals in total.
